show.name: Большое шоу
show.summary: This is Azamat Musagaliyev's Big Show! Ten famous people are competing for a cash prize. The task is simple - DO NOT LAUGH! Who fails - out of the game. The last one, gets everything.

show.name: Unskilled Adult
show.summary:
After years of successfully mucking around for a living, Hamish Blake has realised when it comes to practical skills, he doesn't have many. To remedy this, Hamish starts a business helping real people with jobs they really need done, for real money and putting himself firmly on the hook.

Each week, Hamish recruits two equally underqualified personalities to join him in tackling a challenge none of them are remotely prepared for. From welding a trailer or catering a wedding to drywalling a salami shed and sewing costumes for a community theatre, Hamish and his team will jump in at the deep end and use their wits and lateral thinking to make up for the years of training and experience they're missing. At the end of each job, the client decides what the work is actually worth and how much, if anything, they're prepared to pay.

Expect funny, hilarious and ridiculous moments with Hamish and his hapless employees, as they pick up genuinely useful skills, help everyday Australians and rediscover the satisfaction of learning something new.

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

show.name: The Qinling Bronze Occult Chronicles
show.summary: A bronze tomb anomaly, buried in the aftermath of a 1971 mine disaster deep in the Qinling Mountains, awakens years later. Retired reconnaissance scout Qin Yue leads a team into the heart of the mountain range, venturing into an underground forbidden zone where scientific exploration collides with ancient shamanic rites, to unearth the truth of a blood sacrifice that spans two generations.

show.name: Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
show.summary: Feng Weiyue, a modern-day dimensional research team leader, has an accidents during a space experiment and transmigrates to the Yinbei Dynasty together with her colleague Ye Changjiu and her boss Jun Qingye. Feng Weiyue wakes up in the body of the Grand Tutor's legitimate daughter, only to find herself in the bedchamber of the Prince of Rong, Mo Yuya, stuck with the dreadful reputation of a "boy-crazy princess consort". Meanwhile, Mo Yuya is being constantly targeted for assassination by Gu Nanke, the master of the Xingzhao Pavilion. Feng Weiyue unexpectedly discovers that she shares a tangled connection with Gu Nanke, and the dimensional bracelet she brought through time becomes her ultimate cheat code.

show.summary: Krit, the polished CEO of a data analytics empire, has always put family and duty above his own heart. When a scandal linked to his ex-lover tarnishes his reputation, his controlling mother forces him into a fake marriage with Non—his adopted younger brother who has secretly loved him for years. What begins as a staged arrangement soon turns real as Non steps out of Krit's shadow and catches someone else's eye, awakening emotions Krit can no longer deny. But when their relationship sparks a public scandal, Krit must choose between protecting the perfect life he's built or risking everything for a love he never expected.

show.name: Blue Planet III
show.summary: Blue Planet III will build on its groundbreaking legacy, redefining the realm of possibility in underwater wildlife film-making. Taking the wonder, immersion, and discovery of the Blue Planet brand to extraordinary new depths, it will reveal brand new and untold stories from magical underwater worlds. Combining our deeper understanding of the oceans with a whole new generation of camera technology, we can now showcase stunning stories and extraordinary behaviours, previously impossible to film or only recently discovered.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary: Summer 1989. Bill and his pregnant partner Liz move to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons with Bill's teenage son, Jonathan. Yet on the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams. And as strange events intensify, Bill and Liz are forced to accept a terrifying new reality.

show.name: The Witch Farm
show.summary:
South Wales, 1989. Bill and Liz Rich leave London for Heol Fanog, a remote modern farmhouse in the foothills of the Brecon Beacons, determined to make a fresh start. At first, the isolation feels like freedom. But when, in the midst of a traumatic home birth, Liz becomes convinced she's seen a ghostly figure in the bedroom they start to feel increasingly afraid…

What follows is a steady escalation of the chillingly uncanny - unexplained disturbances and an unsettling sense that they are not alone. As Bill and Liz begin to investigate, the house draws them deeper into a history that refuses to stay buried. And as the land yields its secrets, so too does their marriage - testing the limits of trust, belief, and what they're willing to deny in order to survive.

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary: The family receive a shockingly high electricity bill, and their animals start to behave oddly. Liz meets spiritualist Bethan at a mother and baby group. After a strained Christmas dinner, Jonathan admits he's also seen a ghost. Liz and Bill beg Brecon Council for help, raising the suspicions of social services. Bethan offers to conduct a seance, leading to a shocking conclusion.

show.name: 10 NEWS+
show.summary:
10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates.

10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage.

At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose.

Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere.

The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

body.name: Dreams
body.summary: "Waking up to an ordinary, blissful morning with the family that is no longer with him, Taiyo almost gives in to the deception, even while feeling that something's off. That's when sakura blossoms suddenly start blooming on his hands... When he comes to, Taiyo finds himself trapped by a tentacle growing out of an ominous, giant black sakura tree. Shinzo and Kengo have also been caught, and they're unconscious. And now he's lost contact with Mutsumi and the other siblings! Kai and the other Gold Rank spies can only stand by, unsure of what's going on. To rescue everyone, Taiyo rushes off to find Momo!"

show.name: Mission: Yozakura Family
show.summary: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

show.name: Battle Through the Heavens
show.summary: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

show.name: A la deriva
show.summary: Héctor Parrado's boat sank with crew; no bodies recovered. Families left in limbo. Lucía, Maca, Rosa, Berta, Paloma bond through loss. Two years later, the five fishermen return alive, bringing joy, conflicts, and buried secrets.

show.name: River of No Return
show.summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name written by Ma Boyong, the story follows crown prince Zhu Zhanji, who is trapped in Nanjing and caught in a shocking conspiracy. Together with constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and junior official Yu Qian, he dodges layers of manhunt and travels all the way back to the capital via the Grand Canal within 15 days to receive the imperial edict.

show.summary: Ethan is a good kid born on the wrong side of town. In Cape Town's slums where local gangs make the law, he is soon left with no choice but to work for one of them to support himself and his younger brother. Caught in a web of crime, he discovers he has an incredible talent for spinning, an exciting and extreme motorsport. Could this be his way out from the violent criminal life that seems to be the only option to survive in his neighbourhood?

show.name: City of God: The Fight Rages On
City of God: The Fight Rages On
show.summary: City of God: The Fight Rages On takes place two decades after the events of the highly acclaimed film "City of God." City of God: The Fight Rages On is an adapted continuation of the literary work by Paulo Lins, and will follow the story of its characters, starting with the work of the photographer Buscapé. Set in the early 2000s, the series includes excerpts from the film as flashbacks to reconstruct the protagonists' memories.

show.name: Dushi Gu Xian Yi
show.summary: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

show.name: Still a Family
show.summary: In 2008, with China's economy booming, the Sai Duoxi family living on the Jiaodong Peninsula undergoes a dramatic change. A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.summary: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?

A pure love ready to protect and heal a broken heart. A love that feels like a shackle, surrendering one's heart completely to the power of true love.
